text.en: Shoppers consistently praise team members like Holly and Shannon for their warm customer service and deep animal knowledge. Reviewers appreciate that the staff take ample time to guide new pet owners on proper care routines, enclosure setups, and fitting winter puppy coats.

Visitors describe the Busby premises as a pleasant, well-organised local shop with an extensive inventory of supplies for diverse species. Customers note that they reliably find what they need, ranging from daily essentials to bird care goods and full reptile vivarium setups.

Reviewers who purchased companion animals, including birds and tortoises, note that the pets were healthy, confident, and well socialized. Clients highlight that the obvious care given to animals before rehoming reflects the team's genuine commitment to animal wellbeing.

q.en: Does Creature Comforts sell small companion pets?

a.en: Yes, clients mention acquiring healthy birds and tortoises complete with enclosure setups and care advice.

q.en: Can staff help fit coats or harnesses for dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers praise staff patience when helping find and fit winter coats and accessories for young puppies.

q.en: Does the shop stock bird supplies and accessories?

a.en: Yes, customers note a strong selection of bird-related products, feeds, and accessories in the store.

q.en: Do employees provide guidance for setting up reptile habitats?

a.en: Yes, buyers report that staff explained complete habitat setups thoroughly, ensuring pets settled smoothly.
